rows.label: SHOAL
rows.clue: A sandbank in a stretch of water that is visible at low tide

rows.label: WATER GAP
rows.clue: A pass in a mountain ridge through which a stream flows

rows.label: BINARY
rows.clue: A system of two stars that revolve around each other under their mutual gravitation

rows.label: MOON
rows.clue: The natural satellite of the Earth

rows.label: ION
rows.clue: A particle that is electrically charged (positive or negative)

rows.label: DELTA
rows.clue: A low triangular area of alluvial deposits where a river divides before entering a larger body of water

rows.label: SEA
rows.clue: A division of an ocean or a large body of salt water partially enclosed by land

rows.label: DRIFT ICE
rows.clue: Masses of ice floating in the open sea

rows.label: ELECTRON
rows.clue: An elementary particle with negative charge

rows.label: DEFILE
rows.clue: A narrow pass (especially one between mountains)

rows.label: WORLD
rows.clue: Everything that exists anywhere

rows.label: ICE MASS
rows.clue: A large mass of ice

rows.label: GLACIER
rows.clue: A slowly moving mass of ice

rows.label: FLAT
rows.clue: A level tract of land

rows.label: BUTTE
rows.clue: A hill that rises abruptly from the surrounding region

rows.label: ICE FIELD
rows.clue: A large flat mass of ice (larger than an ice floe) floating at sea

rows.label: ICE CAP
rows.clue: A mass of ice and snow that permanently covers a large area of land (e.g., the polar regions or a mountain peak)

rows.label: LAKE BED
rows.clue: The bottom of a lake

rows.label: WIND GAP
rows.clue: A pass in a mountain ridge with no stream flowing through it

rows.label: SLIVER
rows.clue: A small thin sharp bit or wood or glass or metal

rows.label: GORGE
rows.clue: A deep ravine (usually with a river running through it)

rows.label: TREE FARM
rows.clue: A forest (or part of a forest) where trees are grown for commercial use

rows.label: DUNE
rows.clue: A ridge of sand created by the wind

rows.label: BOG
rows.clue: Wet spongy ground of decomposing vegetation

rows.label: MEANDER
rows.clue: A bend or curve, as in a stream or river

rows.label: TANGLE
rows.clue: A twisted and tangled mass that is highly interwoven

rows.label: STAR
rows.clue: (astronomy) a celestial body of hot gases that radiates energy derived from thermonuclear reactions in the interior

rows.label: PARING
rows.clue: A thin fragment or slice (especially of wood) that has been shaved from something

rows.label: ASTEROID
rows.clue: Any of numerous small celestial bodies composed of rock and metal that move around the sun (mainly between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter)

rows.label: BURROW
rows.clue: A hole made by an animal, usually for shelter

rows.label: HAIR BALL
rows.clue: A compact mass of hair that forms in the alimentary canal (especially in the stomach of animals as a result of licking fur)

rows.label: FOAM
rows.clue: A mass of small bubbles formed in or on a liquid

rows.label: PIT
rows.clue: A sizeable hole (usually in the ground)

rows.label: STREAM
rows.clue: A natural body of running water flowing on or under the earth

rows.label: STONE
rows.clue: A lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter

rows.label: COVERING
rows.clue: A natural object that covers or envelops

rows.label: SHEET
rows.clue: Any broad thin expanse or surface

rows.label: RIDGE
rows.clue: A long narrow natural elevation or striation

rows.label: GULCH
rows.clue: A narrow gorge with a stream running through it

rows.label: HEADLAND
rows.clue: A natural elevation (especially a rocky one that juts out into the sea)

rows.label: FOOTHILL
rows.clue: A relatively low hill on the lower slope of a mountain

rows.label: CASCADE
rows.clue: A small waterfall or series of small waterfalls

rows.label: MAIN
rows.clue: Any very large body of (salt) water

rows.label: BAYOU
rows.clue: A swampy arm or slow-moving outlet of a lake (term used mainly in Mississippi and Louisiana)

rows.label: WOODLAND
rows.clue: Land that is covered with trees and shrubs

rows.label: BIRD NEST
rows.clue: Nest where birds lay their eggs and hatch their young

rows.label: INLET
rows.clue: An arm off of a larger body of water (often between rocky headlands)

rows.label: WATERWAY
rows.clue: A navigable body of water

rows.label: CAPE
rows.clue: A strip of land projecting into a body of water

rows.label: ORE BED
rows.clue: A stratum of ore

rows.label: WORMHOLE
rows.clue: Hole made by a burrowing worm

rows.label: PLATEAU
rows.clue: A relatively flat highland

rows.label: WEB
rows.clue: An intricate network suggesting something that was formed by weaving or interweaving

rows.label: BLUFF
rows.clue: A high steep bank (usually formed by river erosion)

rows.label: CLIMB
rows.clue: An upward slope or grade (as in a road)

rows.label: MOUNTAIN
rows.clue: A land mass that projects well above its surroundings

rows.label: PACK ICE
rows.clue: A large expanse of floating ice

rows.label: DRAW
rows.clue: A gully that is shallower than a ravine

rows.label: WALL ROCK
rows.clue: A rock immediately adjacent to a vein or fault

rows.label: AGENT
rows.clue: An active and efficient cause

rows.label: FIRE PIT
rows.clue: A pit whose floor is incandescent lava

rows.label: GRAIN
rows.clue: A relatively small granular particle of a substance

rows.label: ICE SHELF
rows.clue: Ice that is attached to land but projects out to sea

rows.label: CRATER
rows.clue: A bowl-shaped geological formation at the top of a volcano

rows.label: NUGGET
rows.clue: A solid lump of a precious metal (especially gold) as found in the earth

rows.label: UNIT CELL
rows.clue: The smallest group of atoms or molecules whose repetition at regular intervals in three dimensions produces the lattices of a crystal

rows.label: DELTA RAY
rows.clue: An electron ejected from matter by ionizing radiation

rows.label: ICEBERG
rows.clue: A large mass of ice floating at sea

rows.label: NEUTRON
rows.clue: An elementary particle with 0 charge and mass about equal to a proton

rows.label: BEDROCK
rows.clue: Solid unweathered rock lying beneath surface deposits of soil

rows.label: MIRE
rows.clue: A soft wet area of low-lying land that sinks underfoot

rows.label: POTHOLE
rows.clue: A pit or hole produced by wear or weathering (especially in a road surface)

rows.label: GROTTO
rows.clue: A small cave (usually with attractive features)

rows.label: SIERRA
rows.clue: A range of mountains (usually with jagged peaks and irregular outline)

rows.label: STRAIT
rows.clue: A narrow channel of the sea joining two larger bodies of water

rows.label: STRIP
rows.clue: A relatively long narrow piece of something

rows.label: TRACK
rows.clue: A line or route along which something travels or moves

rows.label: CHASM
rows.clue: A deep opening in the earth's surface

rows.label: CANAL
rows.clue: (astronomy) an indistinct surface feature of Mars once thought to be a system of channels

rows.label: REEF
rows.clue: A submerged ridge of rock or coral near the surface of the water

rows.label: CLIFF
rows.clue: A steep high face of rock

rows.label: GEYSER
rows.clue: A spring that discharges hot water and steam

rows.label: BAY
rows.clue: An indentation of a shoreline larger than a cove but smaller than a gulf

rows.label: SALT FLAT
rows.clue: A flat expanse of salt left by the evaporation of a body of salt water

rows.label: RIFT
rows.clue: A gap between cloud masses

rows.label: SCRAPING
rows.clue: (usually plural) a fragment scraped off of something and collected

rows.label: VARIABLE
rows.clue: Something that is likely to vary

rows.label: STRETCH
rows.clue: A large and unbroken expanse or distance

rows.label: TAR PIT
rows.clue: A natural accumulation of bitumens at the surface of the earth

rows.label: HIGHLAND
rows.clue: Elevated (e.g., mountainous) land

rows.label: REMAINS
rows.clue: Any object that is left unused or still extant

rows.label: LAGOON
rows.clue: A body of water cut off from a larger body by a reef of sand or coral
